title: Walnut & Sage

provenance.author: Artist-2D / OpenAI gpt-6.1-sol
provenance.method: Original hand-authored SVG geometry, Python art-export script, local system librsvg + Cairo; no external artwork or image generator.
provenance.prompt: AO01 local hands/keyboard/under-desk polish only: two continuous shoulder-elbow-forearm-cuff-skin-hand chains over a dark keyboard with three regular key rows; alternating finger presses in two phases, distinct resting idle; separate trouser/shoe silhouettes and lighter chair base with open gaps and soft contact shadows. Preserve accepted walls, floor, ficus scale, face/glasses and production layout. Offline atlas composite, not WebGL.
provenance.seedReason: Deterministic hand-authored geometry; no stochastic generator.
provenance.referenceUse: Own pre-polish offline atlas detail inspected via vision_analyze for hands and under-desk defect correction; no external artwork traced. Null seed: deterministic authored SVG geometry.

atlas.samplingAdvice: Linear or nearest at integer zoom; disable mipmaps for this sample with transparent gutters.

floor_sage.notes: Exact 64x32 diamond; center anchor; no seam outline.

wall_cutaway.notes: Concave interior corner. Foot (112,88) maps to grid back vertex (originX,originY-16); returns end at +/-96,+48; height 72px.

desk_wood.notes: Monitor, keyboard, coffee mug, drawer pedestal and cable are baked into one prop. Facing +Y.

desk_front.notes: Foreground apron only; exact shared desk anchor, masks lap below hands, not face or keyboard.

chair_teal.notes: Unified human scale; chair and seated character share ground registration.

ficus.notes: Subordinate floor plant; 0.46 authored geometry scale, runtime scale 1.

miro_idle.notes: Miro, original fictional developer; seated working silhouette; +X/+Y three-quarter view. Fixed anchor across poses.

miro_typing_01.notes: Miro, original fictional developer; seated working silhouette; +X/+Y three-quarter view. Fixed anchor across poses.

miro_typing_02.notes: Miro, original fictional developer; seated working silhouette; +X/+Y three-quarter view. Fixed anchor across poses.

anchorConvention: footAnchorPx is absolute pixel position within untrimmed source rectangle; Pixi defaultAnchor=footAnchorPx/sourceSize. Floor uses center; furniture uses ground contact/sort point. Draw position equals ground anchor.
assemblyNotes: Runtime scale is 1 for all frames; scene may be uniformly enlarged for inspection.
3x3 floor uses 64x32 frames with center anchor and 32/16 steps.
Concave wall foot (112,88) maps to originX,originY-16; both 96x48 returns align with full back boundaries.
Desk desktop z240, Miro z250, foreground apron z300; apron and desktop share anchor (80,118).
Chair and seated Miro share ground position (0.35,1.15).
Ficus is authored at 0.46 of former geometry about its ground anchor; chair and Miro at 0.72.
Contact vignette reads production calculateDioramaLayout; artifacts/reproduce_layout.py crops the actual runtime atlas. Neither is a WebGL screenshot.

review.canvasIntegration: Production layout and split apron updated in tycoonAssets.ts; offline atlas composite inspected; WebGL gate pending.
